summary: The supplied desktop and mobile screenshots show a readable review queue and clear status hierarchy. The visible issues are minor layout and readability concerns.

findings.description: [suggestion] In 01-desktop-full.png, the detail panel ends about 190 px above the queue, leaving a wide empty region beside the last two specifications. Rebalance the columns so the bottom of the queue feels less isolated.

[suggestion] In 02-mobile-top.png, the Critical Attention card wraps its heading and both metric labels across two lines. Give this card more horizontal room or shorten the labels so the two values are easier to scan.
